noun_definition: url refers to the web address that should be displayed in the bottom left corner of the screen when hovering over the social media icons on the sign-in page.
Bottom left refers to the area of the browser window where the URL of a link is expected to be displayed when hovering over the social media icons on the sign-in page.
Social media icon refers to the graphical representations of social media platforms displayed on the sign-in page that should show a URL in the bottom left corner when hovered over.
Sign in page refers to the web interface where users can log into their accounts, specifically the page accessed at the provided URL where social media icons are present.
